name: ledger
description: Ledger — a life in decisions. One simulation, two apps, one HTML file.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix tools && npm install --prefix .harness && cd .harness && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:shell && npm run test:gates
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.deploy:pages: git subtree split --prefix ledger -b gh-pages-next && git push -f origin gh-pages-next:gh-pages && git branch -D gh-pages-next
scripts.deploy:static: docker build -f Dockerfile.static -t ledger-static . && docker run --rm -p 8080:80 ledger-static
scripts.deploy:app: docker build -t ledger-app . && docker run --rm -p 3007:3007 ledger-app
